chamfer_policy: Original native raw filled CD mean, then clip normalized aggregate score at zero.
cost_policy: Local checkpoint inference; hosted-model API-equivalent generation cost is not applicable.
judge_aggregation: Original Text2CAD native success-only QA/J-Sem means; not the general-model fixed-N Judge aggregation.
per_case_policy: Per-case Geometry uses four diagnostic terms. Aggregate Geometry retains the original metric-first statistics; all primitive metric policies are unchanged.
scope: Native JSON-only baseline; not a JSON/OpenSCAD two-format average.
text_score: 100 * mean(descriptive Judge, parametric Geometry, parametric Judge); Topology reported separately.
